Case_23003/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Figure 1a. CT scan of chest without contrast

description.short_caption: Axial chest CT without contrast showing bilateral lung findings.
description.detailed_description: This axial CT image of the chest, taken without contrast, shows both lungs. There are multiple small, round, nodular opacities distributed throughout both lung fields, consistent with a miliary pattern. The mediastinum appears unremarkable, and there is no visible pleural effusion. The image is de-identified and includes a watermark indicating its source.

Case_23003/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Figure 1b: CT scan of chest without contrast

description.short_caption: Axial CT scan of the chest without contrast showing bilateral pulmonary findings.
description.detailed_description: This axial CT scan of the chest, performed without contrast, demonstrates bilateral lung abnormalities. There are multiple nodular opacities and areas of ground-glass attenuation scattered throughout both lungs. The trachea and main bronchi are patent, and no significant pleural effusion is visible. The findings suggest a diffuse pulmonary process, potentially infectious or inflammatory in nature.

Case_23003/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Figure 1c: CT scan of chest without contrast

description.short_caption: Axial chest CT without contrast showing bilateral lung abnormalities.
description.detailed_description: This axial chest CT image, performed without contrast, demonstrates significant abnormalities in both lungs. The left lung shows areas of ground-glass opacities and consolidation, while the right lung exhibits similar findings but to a lesser extent. The mediastinum and heart appear unremarkable. The findings suggest a diffuse infectious or inflammatory process.
visible_findings: ground-glass opacities in the left lung
milder abnormalities in the right lung

Case_23003/figure4.jpg.source_caption: MRI scan of the brain with and without contrast

description.short_caption: MRI of the brain showing multiple ring-enhancing lesions.
description.detailed_description: This image shows axial MRI slices of the brain, both with and without contrast. Multiple ring-enhancing lesions are visible, predominantly in the cerebral hemispheres and cerebellum. These lesions exhibit surrounding edema, as evidenced by hyperintense signals on T2-weighted or FLAIR sequences. The findings are suggestive of infectious or neoplastic processes, such as abscesses or metastases.
visible_findings: lesions in cerebral hemispheres and cerebellum

Case_23003/figure5.jpg.source_caption: MRI scan of the brain with and without contrast

description.short_caption: Histopathology of brain tissue showing inflammation and parasitic cysts.
description.detailed_description: This image shows two histopathology slides of brain tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E). The left panel displays diffuse inflammation with scattered inflammatory cells and disrupted tissue architecture. The right panel highlights a parasitic cyst surrounded by inflammatory cells, suggesting a parasitic infection. The cyst appears to contain a dense cluster of organisms or parasitic structures.
visible_findings: parasitic cyst with dense internal structures
